column3: Safety boundary -> simulation-only - Agent-touched code must not connect to live order routing.
Market timestamps -> exchange-time - State the timezone explicitly.
Missing market data -> surface-gaps - Never silently pad or interpolate.
Review scope -> expanded-captures - Recover every structured answer.
Completeness verdict -> count-all - Declared and presented counts must agree.
Durable record -> preserve-note - Keep the captain's typed rationale.
Close behavior -> announce-answers - Do not call a populated close empty.
